question: What is a family secret that came out at the worst possible time?
story: My grandma left me her entire house in her will, and my family is convinced it was a typo. It was not a typo. Here is what nobody knows. For six years, I drove two hours every Sunday to sit with her while everyone else was too busy. I fixed her gutters. I paid her heating bill twice when money was tight. I never told a soul, because she asked me not to. When the will was read, my aunt actually laughed and said Grandma must have been confused. So I pulled out a shoebox. Inside were handwritten notes from every single visit, six years of them, all signed by her. The room went dead quiet. My aunt has not spoken to me since, and honestly, that house is the most peaceful it has ever been. I think Grandma would love that.
